title: Korzo Soblahovská
description:
For one day, Soblahovská belongs to people. No cars – instead a street filled with a market, music, food and a friendly neighbourhood atmosphere. Come for a walk, stop by, sit down and discover what a city street can become when we look at it differently.

Korzo Soblahovská is a modern urban market and a full-day gathering for families, neighbours and people from across the region. Together with Trenčín na Korze, we show that public space can be used comfortably, safely and with joy – not only in the city centre.
